'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Do you like classic literature? Why do you think Dostoevsky is so popular with those who've never been to Russia? I've been wondering about it for a while until this TerraGroup scandal emerged. Its executives, I assume, were very familiar with classics and what they do to us. Such a situation can only be pulled in a society where people can combine both lies and betrayal and irrational, unexplainable self-sacrifice, which are more abundant in Tarkov than in any other place. Dostoevsky wrote about it, these people can live with the highest commitment to other people and at the same time be the best at killing. Sometimes we forget about this. The next task from Sniper is your personal count, and not in cash, obviously.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 5 PMC operatives with a [[Weapons#Bolt-action rifles|bolt-action rifle]] without dying

==Rewards==
* +65,000 [[EXP]]
* 1× [[SWORD International Mk-18 .338 LM marksman rifle]]
* 1× [[Mk-18 .338 LM 10-round magazine]]
* 1× [[.338 Lapua Magnum FMJ ammo pack (20 pcs)]]
* Unlocks purchase of [[SWORD International Mk-18 .338 LM marksman rifle]] at [[Jaeger]] LL4
{{quote|It seems that sometimes being smart isn’t enough to act smart. Well, a good old bolty can be of help with this. Sniper is silent for now, so let's wait for a little before your next tasks. I will let you know when there are new tests for you.}}

==Failure Dialogue==
{{quote|This is not an easy task. Try again.}}

==Guide==
The kills can be done over multiple raids, but dying at any point before actually handing in the completed quest will fail it.
